title: Kainuu: 1.2 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €79,900 a year
markdown:
# Kainuu: 1.2 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €79,900 a year

> Closes 1.2 of 2.8 missing patients a year (42%) · €79,900 of €1M · €920,100 left: nothing more pays off on today's evidence

## The gap

Of 100 lung cancer patients in Kainuu, 8 are operated. In Finland it is 15. That is about 3 patients a year. [^care_surgery] Compared with the best quarter of counties, 4.3 patients a year (range 1.6–6.6) are missing from treatment that aims to cure. [^care_curative] [^model] Against Finland as a whole, 2.8 fewer a year are operated and 0.0 fewer get radiotherapy that aims to cure. [^care_curative] [^model] Patients in the OYS collaborative area do not wait longer from diagnosis to first treatment than in Finland: 31.2 days against 36.9. [^care_time_to_treatment] In Kainuu, fewer are treated to cure. [^care_curative]

## The target

Raise the share of lung cancer patients treated to cure from 20.8% to 23.4% by 2028: 1.2 more patients a year (range 0.0–1.8), for €79,900 a year, about €68,879 per extra patient. [^care_curative][^model] That closes 42% of the measured shortfall against Finland as a whole (2.8 patients a year). [^model]

## Funded actions

| # | Action and owner | Cost a year | More patients treated to cure a year (range) | First step this week | Measure: today → target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | **The county can start on Monday** | | | | |
| 1 | **Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated**[^ev_sbrt_pathway_1]. Chief physician of oncology; chief of radiotherapy at the university hospital | €11,040 | 0.3 (0.0–0.2) | Write the referral rule: every stage I patient not accepted for surgery is referred for stereotactic radiotherapy the same week. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 20.8% → 21.4% by 2028 |
| 2 | **Travel and hotel paid for patients far from the university hospital**[^ev_travel_accommodation_support_1]. Chief physician of oncology and hospital social work; university hospital patient hotel | €14,560 | 0.3 (0.0–0.3) | Name one contact person who books the patient hotel and transport for every patient sent to the university hospital for curative treatment. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 20.8% → 21.4% by 2028 |
| 3 | **Fitness test and training before anyone is ruled too frail for curative treatment**[^ev_prehab_fitness_assessment_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; leads of rehabilitation and geriatrics | €13,300 | 0.1 (0.0–0.2) | Decide that no stage I-III patient is recorded as "not fit" without an exercise test, and book the physiotherapy group. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 20.8% → 21.1% by 2028 |
| | **Needs the collaborative area (university hospital)** | | | | |
| 4 | **A chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate**[^ev_surgeon_second_opinion_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; chief of thoracic surgery at the university hospital | €41,000 | 0.5 (0.0–1.1) | Agree with the university hospital that a thoracic surgeon joins the weekly lung meeting, and send last quarter's stage I-II patients who were not operated for a second look. | Share of patients operated: 7.5% → 8.7% by 2028 |
| | **Total** | **€79,900** | **1.2 (0.0–1.8)** | | |

No trial has measured these effects; the low end of every range is zero. The ranges do not add up to the range of the total, because the measures share one ceiling. Costs are assumptions. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €227,579 a year; modelled to avoid 0.4 deaths a year (0.1–0.9). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Share of patients treated to cure: 20.8% (2019–2023, measured) → 23.4% by 2028. [^care_curative][^model]
- Share of patients operated: 7.5% → 8.7% by 2028. [^care_surgery][^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

The remaining €920,100 buys nothing more toward treatment to cure in the model. [^model] The measures are limited by the part of the measured shortfall they can reach, not by money. [^model] More could come from low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers, which needs a national decision, or from ranking measures by deaths avoided instead. [^model] Lung cancer causes about 41 deaths a year in Kainuu, and this plan is modelled to avoid 0.2 of them (0.0-0.5). [^deaths] [^model]

## Pilot ask

A six-month pilot of two actions: a chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate, and every patient who cannot be operated is referred for precise radiotherapy. In six months that is about 23 new patients and 21 decisions reviewed. If our assumptions hold, about 0 of them (0 to 1) move to treatment that aims to cure in that time, and the share rises from 20.8% to 22.5% by 2028. The pilot replaces those assumptions with a count. [^model]

## Limits

- Effects are ranges, not probabilities. Each range runs from lowest to highest as every assumed effect moves together, and no trial has measured them. [^model]
- Shares are adjusted only for residents' age, not for stage at diagnosis, other illness, histology, smoking or recording. County figures cannot show cause. [^model]
- A check found 0 of 3 outcomes matched the estimated symptom-to-treatment clock beyond chance. [^model]

removed.reason: Not in the source: the material calls the clock a secondary, estimated view but never says the plan does not use it. The sentence was cut and the following check sentence was reworded to name the clock, which it previously referred to only as 'it'.

flagged.reason: Following the OYS collaborative area sentence, this read as an area-level claim. The curative-treatment share is measured for the county, so it now reads 'In Kainuu, fewer are treated to cure.'

flagged.sentence: The remaining €920,100 buys nothing more toward treatment to cure.
flagged.reason: It had no source marker, and it stated a model result as fact. Added [^model] and 'in the model', as the source says.

pilot.cannot_show_en: Six months is too short to show the county's share moving. It is long enough to count reviews done, decisions changed and referrals made, against the same six months a year earlier.
